Everyone wants to build the next unicorn… but the real opportunities lie in solving problems nobody else is looking at. In this video, we break down five high-potential sectors that could create India’s next 100 unicorns between 2025–2035.
What you’ll learn:
1⃣ Vernacular AI & Bharat-First SaaS (powered by UPI AutoPay)
2⃣ Longevity & Personalized Healthcare
3⃣ MSME Credit & Alternative FinTech
4⃣ ClimateTech & Sustainability
5⃣ India’s Industrial & DeepTech Revolution
